card.name: Link labels in square brackets
card.fires_on: The label word inside square brackets that marks a link or source, mainly PubMed and PDF, after a citation or a linked phrase. Also a few similar bracketed labels such as WARN(INGS) and download(able).

modes.label: PubMed link tag
modes.description: PubMed placed in brackets in a reference entry, followed by an ID number.

modes.label: PDF link tag
modes.description: PDF in brackets right after a linked phrase or handout title in web text.
modes.example: Handout 2: The Real World of Our Town [<<PDF>>] Handout 3: Thornton Wild

modes.label: Other bracketed labels
modes.description: A bracketed section label whose first piece is the marked word, such as WARN in a label heading.
modes.example: opioid overdose reversal agent [<< WARN>>INGS, DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION].

card.plain: It marks the bracketed tag in a citation or link, such as PubMed or PDF, that points to a source document.
